name: Offline field notes
purpose: Capture field notes offline and restore an owner-exported backup
differentiators: Timestamped notes with a reversible local backup workflow
acceptance: Create and edit a note offline, restart the app and recover the saved text
Export notes, delete local data and restore the same notes from the export
Complete both workflows with large text and screen-reader labels; save actual device screenshots
constraints: Use Flutter with real integration_test/app_test.dart and test_driver/integration_test.dart runtime coverage
No accounts, tracking, hidden features or network dependency
